statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while Stress is extreme ahead of the U.S. cash open and a dense data-and-Fed sequence.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains below the block threshold, with the main conditional risk window at 13:30–15:30 UTC around the cash open and the 14:00–14:20 UTC event cluster.
headline: Nasdaq futures pause after the AI rally as semiconductor breadth lags ahead of the U.S. event cluster
body: Delayed public December NQ quotes remain inside the overnight range. Fresh supplementary breadth is split: six of eight tracked megacaps are positive while only two of seven tracked semiconductors are positive and Technology is roughly flat. VIX is near 14.7 and oil has eased from earlier highs. No repeated failed-retracement sequence is verified, so current Tail remains low while Stress is extreme.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours span Monday’s strong trend-up phase, when Tail peaked at 38% at 19:00 UTC, followed by rapid post-close normalization. Overnight and European-morning assessments were mostly low, with WATCH readings at 22:00–23:00 UTC and 04:00 UTC before returning to low through 10:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Tail is low before the U.S. open and remains below the block threshold without verified persistent mean-reversion failure. Conditional risk concentrates from 13:30–15:30 UTC around the cash open and the 14:00–14:20 UTC survey-and-Fed cluster, then can de-escalate if price discovery becomes two-way.

forecast.analysis: Delayed public December NQ quotes are inside the overnight range, while fresh supplementary breadth is split: megacaps are mostly positive but semiconductors are mostly negative. With VIX near 14.7 and no verified failed-retracement sequence, current Tail remains low.
drivers: Delayed NQ quote is inside the overnight range without a verified pullback sequence
Fresh megacap breadth is positive while semiconductor breadth is negative
VIX is near 14.7 while oil has eased below earlier highs

news.title: Wall St futures pause after AI rally, focus on Mideast tensions

forecast.analysis: ADP NER Pulse is scheduled for 12:15 UTC. Stress rises into the release, while Tail stays WATCH unless the observed response shows repeated extension, failed retracements or near-extreme holding.
drivers: Premarket pullback quality after the release

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open occurs at 13:30 UTC. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction continuation, shallow pullbacks or repeated extension; a deeper counter-move would argue for rapid de-escalation.
drivers: 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and opening-auction structure

forecast.analysis: Richmond surveys, Williams at 14:05 UTC and Jefferson at 14:20 UTC cluster in this hour. Tail peaks conditionally only if the observed price path becomes persistently one-way after the releases and remarks.
The first post-cluster hour remains elevated only if the initial move resists meaningful retracement and keeps extending. Two-way price discovery would reduce Tail quickly despite still-high Stress.
By midday, conditional Tail falls back to WATCH if price discovery becomes rotational. Near-extreme holding with weak counter-moves would be the main reason for risk to stay elevated.
Barkin is scheduled at 17:00 UTC with Q&A. The event adds Stress; Tail stays WATCH unless remarks reinforce an already persistent directional structure with weak retracements.
drivers: Tom Barkin remarks and Q&A at 17:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: After Barkin, conditional Tail eases if two-way trade resumes. Continued extension with weak retracement would keep the path more fragile into the late session.
Power hour begins at 19:00 UTC. WATCH reflects late-session continuation risk, but a block would still require actual failed pullbacks, repeated extension or sustained near-extreme holding.
The U.S. cash close occurs at 20:00 UTC. Balanced closing flows would reduce path risk; an extreme close after repeated failed retracements would preserve a higher Tail into the break.
drivers: 20:00 UTC cash close and closing-auction balance

forecast.analysis: CME equity-index futures enter the 21:00–22:00 UTC maintenance interval. Tail is low during the pause in continuous price discovery; the reopen gap becomes the next structural checkpoint.
Globex reopens at 22:00 UTC. Tail remains low unless an abnormal gap is followed by persistent extension with little meaningful retracement.
Early Asia liquidity is thinner. Tail remains low unless the reopen move persists into the regional handoff with reinforcing technology, rates or oil signals.
With Asia established, Tail stays low if trade is rotational. A one-way move would need repeated extension and shallow pullbacks before the path is treated as persistently hostile to mean reversion.
No major U.S. catalyst is identified in this hour. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding near an overnight extreme while counter-moves remain unusually shallow.
drivers: Overnight directional efficiency and session extremes

forecast.analysis: As Asia progresses, generic volatility mainly affects Stress. Tail would require failed mean reversion plus stronger cross-market alignment before moving materially higher.
drivers: Asia cross-market alignment without assumed path persistence

forecast.analysis: Late-Asia positioning sets up the European handoff. Tail remains low unless a directional move survives pullbacks and carries into the next regional liquidity transition.
Ahead of Europe, liquidity broadens. Tail remains below WATCH unless price is stretched near an extreme and European flows reinforce the same direction with weak retracement.
drivers: Europe pre-open liquidity and near-extreme holding

forecast.analysis: European pre-open flows can challenge the overnight move. Rejection would favor mean reversion; repeated extension would raise conditional Tail for the later U.S. handoff.
European cash liquidity is active. Tail stays just below WATCH unless regional flows produce sustained directional efficiency with shallow pullbacks.
European follow-through is the test. Mean reversion keeps Tail low; multiple failed pullbacks would raise risk into the later U.S. handoff.
By European mid-morning, Tail reaches WATCH conditionally. No future path is assumed; escalation still requires observed persistence, near-extreme holding or failed retracements.
The Europe-to-U.S. lead-in raises sensitivity. Tail remains WATCH while a higher policy state still requires observed near-extreme holding or repeated failure of retracements.
drivers: Europe-to-U.S. lead-in and later premarket liquidity

forecast.analysis: U.S. premarket liquidity should deepen through this hour. Tail remains WATCH unless a directional move becomes more efficient, holds near an extreme and repeatedly rejects counter-moves.
drivers: U.S. premarket liquidity and pullback quality

forecastDetail.comment: Current Tail remains low: delayed NQ is range-bound, breadth is split, and no failed-retracement sequence is verified.
ADP raises Stress; Tail is WATCH only if the observed response becomes persistently one-way.
Cash-open Tail is elevated only if opening continuation resists meaningful retracement.
The 14:00–14:20 UTC cluster is the peak conditional hour; Tail requires observed one-way follow-through.
Post-cluster Tail stays elevated only while the first move resists retracement and keeps extending.
Midday risk falls to WATCH if trade becomes rotational; near-extreme holding would keep Tail higher.
